scripts.build: unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME VIRTUAL_ENV; python3 scripts/build_site.py
scripts.audit: unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME VIRTUAL_ENV; python3 scripts/audit_static_site.py
scripts.test: unset PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME VIRTUAL_ENV; python3 scripts/build_site.py --bootstrap-only && .build-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/sync_quote_adapter.mjs
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.153.0 pages deploy dist --project-name etf-rotation-blog --commit-dirty=true
